verdict.rationale: Canny's integrations directory says feedback can be sent to Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana, linked to existing issues or tasks, and kept in status sync. That directly covers turning a submission into an actionable task. The MCP server adds moving ideas through the workflow and drafting PRDs from real requests. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how a submission becomes a task (fields, one-click flow, project-level creation), independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail beyond one-line vendor claims.
